description: Golden reference for PEEC-inductance (coil only, STEP) on a 355deg gapped-torus coil.
rationale: Locks in the STEP-only centerline extraction + analytical TORUS sweep + n_peri=16 perimeter PEEC solve.  Regressions in extract_centerline_from_step dispatch (loft / TORUS / open-spine) or filaments_from_polyline fail loudly here.  The sample is a pure geometric problem so the expected L tracks the analytical formula tightly.  Since 4.12.0 (m-only policy, auto-detect removed), all PEEC inputs must be in metres -- this STEP sample is.

sample.comment: Cubit session in metres; STEP numeric values in metres (the file's CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT('MILLIMETRE') header is misleading -- Cubit's STEP writer does not convert).  Default cad_units_per_meter=1.0 (metres) per CLAUDE.md "Unit System Policy: Radia always uses meters".

reference_analytical.comment: Thin-wire self-inductance of a circular loop (Maxwell) adjusted for the 5deg gap.  Analytical assumes uniform current on a 1D filament.  Perimeter-placed PEEC with n_peri=16 underestimates by 3-5% (current redistributes to the outer perimeter, effective loop radius slightly smaller).

expected.note_2026_05_20: Updated R/L for: (a) Bessel-skin Zs_fil fix (v4.55.4, 2026-05-19) -- R 0.118 (R_DC) -> 0.6245 mOhm at 50 kHz (a/delta=10.15); (b) proximity-iterative default (v4.57.0, 2026-05-20) -- R 0.6245 -> 0.6496 mOhm, factor 1.040.  Single-turn gapped torus sees small proximity (4%) -- no neighbour-turn coupling, only self-coupling around the loop.  Pre-2026-05-20 the golden's R=0.118 was stale (R_DC) since the v4.12.0 generation.

regression_guard.comment: Hard band: if L falls outside [80, 92], something broke at order-of-magnitude level.  2026-04-21 bug: filaments_from_step default cad_units_per_meter=1000 over-scaled metre-unit STEP, L dropped to 0.086 nH -- hit this band.  2026-04-28 fix (4.12.0): default switched to 1.0 (metres only); auto-detect heuristic removed per CLAUDE.md No-Fallbacks policy.
